description:
Senior Data Engineer

Location: Remote. (Eastern & Central time zones only. Some travel required.)

About Us

Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways. A college education was always meant to lead to economic mobility. But with rising costs and shrinking loan availability, many working-class and first-generation students don’t have the money they need to finish school. That’s where Clasp comes in. We’re the market leader in institutionally funded gap loan programs. We partner with schools to design, launch and manage lending programs that keep students enrolled, graduating and thriving.

Fresh off our Series B, Clasp is entering its next phase of growth. Recent recognition includes:

  • TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026 (Loan-Linked Hiring)

  • Forbes Fintech 50

  • Business Insider: Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026 and 43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025

Our work spans two business lines:

Clasp Talent helps healthcare employers attract and retain critical talent by connecting them with diverse candidates and using student loan repayment as a powerful recruiting and retention tool. We meaningfully connect employers, educational institutions, and learners to drive mutual benefit.

Clasp Student Finance equips colleges and universities with lending technology to launch and operate their own private student loan programs, enabling schools to step in and support their students directly with financial aid. Recent federal financial aid changes are reshaping how institutions think about supporting their students, and Clasp Student Finance is poised to meet this moment. This role is focused solely on Clasp Student Finance. You can learn more about this business line here.

Who We Need

Clasp is hiring a Senior Data Engineer to be a technical owner of our data platform. You'll design, scale, and evolve the pipelines and architecture that deliver reliable data on student loans, educational enrollment, and employment to teams across Clasp Student Finance and Clasp Talent, and to our partners. You'll take on complex, ambiguous problems on your own, make sound architectural tradeoffs, and think ahead to how those decisions affect downstream teams, systems, and the business. You'll also mentor teammates and build the patterns, tooling, and AI-supported workflows that raise the bar for the whole data team. The payoff for Clasp is a data platform that scales with the business: fewer outages, faster answers, and higher-quality data behind better decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the reliability, scalability, and long-term direction of Clasp's data pipeline end to end

  • Design, build, and maintain DAGs and dbt models, and set the modeling standards and patterns the team follows

  • Architect ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from third-party APIs, databases, and flat files, with monitoring, testing, and failure handling built in

  • Lead design for new data sources and models, and evolve our cloud data architecture so data stays secure, accessible, cost-efficient, and well-governed

  • Diagnose complex pipeline failures across upstream sources, transformation logic, and infrastructure, then put systemic fixes, alerting, and runbooks in place so issues don't recur

  • Partner with stakeholders to anticipate their data needs, navigate competing priorities, and deliver reliable, well-documented data products

  • Identify business continuity risks and single points of failure in the platform, and lead improvements to developer experience and platform architecture

  • Raise the quality bar through thorough design and code reviews, and mentor teammates formally and informally

  • Take an AI-first approach to documentation, tooling, and workflows so the team's knowledge of the codebase scales beyond any one person

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, including ownership of production pipelines and architecture decisions

  • Deep expertise designing, building, and maintaining DAGs and dbt models, including setting the modeling standards and patterns others follow

  • Proven experience architecting ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from third-party APIs, databases, and flat files, with monitoring, testing, and failure handling built in

  • Experience designing cloud-based data architecture and making explicit tradeoffs between security, accessibility, cost efficiency, and governance

  • Strong judgment in ambiguous situations: you make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance speed, quality, and long-term impact, and you set new patterns when existing ones fall short

  • A track record of owning relationships with non-technical stakeholders and turning their needs into reliable, well-documented data products

  • Clear, early communication, both synchronous and asynchronous, especially around risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions

  • Experience mentoring engineers and giving thorough design and code reviews

  • Comfort with high autonomy on a fast-paced, high-performing team, with the ownership and follow-through to set the pace for others

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve documentation, tooling, and engineering workflows

What We Give In Return

  • Competitive cash and equity compensation

  • Health benefits (health, dental, & vision)

  • 401k + match

  • Flexible PTO policy

  • Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team

Salary

The salary range for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and industry knowledge, ranging between $135,000 to $165,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, we offer an attractive equity component as part of our compensation package, providing an opportunity for eligible employees to share in the success and growth of our company. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent.

Working at Clasp
Clasp is moving to a remote-first model in 2027. We've built our tools and norms to support flexible, focused work wherever you do your best thinking. To keep collaboration real-time, we hire team members based in the Eastern and Central time zones. Remote-first doesn't mean remote-only. We invest in intentional in-person time to strengthen relationships and stay connected to our mission. Team members should expect company-paid travel up to seven times per year, typically two to four days at a time, for team and company-wide gatherings, in addition to any role-specific travel.

Work authorization
This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer.

How we use AI in hiring
Clasp uses AI-assisted tools in parts of our hiring process, such as AI notetakers transcribing or summarizing interviews, scheduling, and supporting evaluation in technical assessments. Humans review applications and make every hiring decision. AI tools don't make final decisions about any candidate. You're welcome to use AI to research Clasp and prepare, but during live interviews and assessments we want to hear your own thinking, so please don't use AI tools that generate or feed you responses in real time. If you'd like to be evaluated without AI tools, need an accommodation, or have questions about how we use these tools, email recruiting@clasp.com and we'll arrange another process where we can.

Equal opportunity
Clasp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status (except as required by law), or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in line with applicable fair chance laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, email recruiting@clasp.com.
